artworks.title: Bearded Man with Turban and Young Woman
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of two figures positioned back-to-back. The main figure is an older man with a prominent profile, featuring a strong nose, a beard, and weathered facial features. He wears a large turban adorned with a tall feather plume and richly detailed clothing. Partially visible behind him is a second figure, a young person with eyes closed and head slightly tilted, also wearing a turban with feathers. The background is textured with a circular area, and the scene is rendered in monochrome style, surrounded by a plain border with text at the bottom detailing a dedication.

artworks.title: Ophelia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image features a detailed portrait of a woman from the waist up, depicted in a slightly turned position looking to her left. She has delicate facial features with a high forehead, a straight nose, full lips, and downward-cast eyes. Her long, wavy, dark hair flows over her shoulders, adorned with a crown of flowers and foliage. She wears a light-colored, flowing garment with loose sleeves and holds a bouquet of flowers. The background is a simple textured oval vignette with the name "Ophelia" inscribed above her head.

artworks.title: Shylock
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image features a man's upper body positioned slightly to the side. His head is turned forward. He has a prominent nose, intense eyes, a full beard, a mustache, long curly hair falling to his shoulders, and is wearing a cap. He is dressed in a buttoned-up garment with visible seams and a layered collar, detailed with buttons. His left hand is near his chest, holding a rolled document or scroll. The background is a textured oval shape enclosing the portrait within a rectangular frame labeled "SHYLOCK" at the top, with a decorative flourish at the bottom containing a quote. The border around the image is plain.

artworks.title: The Immaculate Conception with God the Father and Angels
artworks.medium: black and white chalks on gray-green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: The sketch features several figures. In the center, a bearded man with a raised arm is depicted. He is seated on a draped surface. Surrounding him are other figures, including a woman reaching out with one arm and another figure partially kneeling. The sketch is rendered in simple lines on plain, aged paper.

artworks.title: Terra (Earth)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical female figure surrounded by elements of nature. The central figure is a female with a wreath of flowers, seated and holding a cornucopia overflowing with fruits and vegetables. She sits within an elaborate oval frame, and is flanked by cherubs who hold branches. Surrounding her are scenes depicting wildlife, such as birds, sheep, cows, and other animals grazing and resting within a richly detailed landscape. In the background, rolling hills and trees add depth. The lower foreground features various fruits scattered around. The drawing captures a harmonious relationship between nature and its nurturing essence, with finely detailed elements and a classical style.

artworks.title: Aqua (Water)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a classical-style engraving of a person seated with one arm resting on a vessel from which water flows. The person has classical facial features and long hair adorned with foliage. They are draped in cloth, surrounded by large leaves and plants. The background features mountains, a body of water with ships, a sea creature, clouds, and sun beams. Cherub-like figures and intricate designs are at the edges of the oval frame.

artworks.title: Ignis (Fire)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a muscular man seated in a dynamic position. He has a strong jawline, prominent cheekbones, and curly hair framing his head like a halo. He is draped in a flowing cloth, holding a three-pronged object in his right hand. Creatures like a lizard and a snake are around him. A decorative border surrounds the artwork featuring clouds and two putti figures. The background shows erupting volcanoes, billowing clouds, and a smoking cauldron.

artworks.title: Aër (Air)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This drawing features an allegorical figure in a classical landscape. The central male figure is sitting on a cloud, holding a chameleon in one hand and gesturing towards the environment with the other. His hair resembles clouds. Surrounding him are four infant-like figures blowing air. The scene is set within an oval border, and beyond it are various landscapes. Birds are flying across the sky. Below, mythological events are depicted in a forested mountainous landscape with a river. Latin text decorates the bottom. The artwork's intricate detailing and rich classical style evoke a Baroque influence, with an emphasis on dynamic composition and allegorical symbolism.

artworks.title: La lezione di violincello [The Violin Lesson]
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on chine collé [proof before letters]
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate interior setting with intricate wall decorations, a large painting or mural on the wall, and elaborate architectural elements. The room features a richly patterned rug, a table lamp, sculptural vase, and draped fabric, conveying a sense of opulence and old-world charm through meticulous attention to decorative detail.

artworks.title: Artillery Soldier on Horseback (Soldato di artiglieria a cavallo)
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper (artist's proof)
artworks.description: The image depicts the back view of a person riding a horse. Both the rider and the horse are fully visible. The rider is upright on the horse, facing away from the viewer. The person's facial features are not visible. The rider has short hair and is wearing a fitted jacket with a strap across their back. The horse is stepping forward, displaying its robust physique and tail. In the background, there are trees to the left and an open landscape with distant fields or plains.

artworks.title: Ferry on the Big Blue, Kansas (Landers Expedition)
artworks.description: The image displays a ferry scene captured in a split or stereoscopic view, showing a tranquil moment at the Big Blue in Kansas. The viewer's perspective is from the riverbank, looking across a body of water toward a ferry in transit. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the scene where the land meets the sky, and trees can be seen along the riverbank and rising toward the horizon. The ferry carries a horse-drawn covered wagon, with several figures and animals visible aboard, and it is tethered by ropes running across the river. The color palette is monochrome, with various shades of gray, as this is a black-and-white photograph, highlighting the diffused light and reflective surface of the water. Trees line the banks, with their leaves and branches creating a gentle framing around the ferry, while their reflections dance subtly in the water.

artworks.title: General View from the American Side (Niagara Falls)
artworks.description: The image is a stereoscopic card featuring a view of a waterfall, presumably Niagara Falls, from the American side. The point of view is from a vantage point on the ground with a direct line of sight to the cascading falls in the distance. Close to us, there is a group of people standing on the rocky terrain, wearing 19th-century attire, with some greenery present. The horizon is obscured by the mist rising from the waterfall. The overall color palette is muted, with earthy browns and greens on the terrain and a light blue to the sky. The waterfall itself is captured with a sense of movement but remains calm and dignified in its depiction. The stereoscopic format offers a dual view that enhances the three-dimensional effect for the viewer.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1739: Mount Parnassus with Apollo, the Muses, and Pegasus
artworks.artist: Miguel de Sorellò, after Pierre Parrocel, after Michelangelo Specchi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene on Mount Parnassus. Various figures are depicted on rocky cliffs with a backdrop of trees and clouds. At the top, there is a figure with a radiant aura, alongside mythical creatures like a winged horse. The scene is dynamic and dramatic, with figures in various poses, some gesturing upwards, others seated or leaning on rocks. The foreground shows figures in contemplative postures, gazing upwards towards the gathering above. The detailed line work conveys depth and texture, typical of classical mythological illustrations.

artworks.title: Fan with Poppies
artworks.medium: gouache on blue silk, partially faded, with pieces of paper residue marking the edges of the fan shape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Pia Gallo in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a large fan-shaped design with vibrant yellow and red flowers as the central objects, set against a muted gray background. The color palette includes soft grays and blues, with splashes of bright red, yellow, and green from the flowers and foliage. Positioned in the center is a cluster of red flowers surrounded by delicate branches with yellow blooms. A single yellow flower stands out on the right. The edge of the fan is bordered with a blue trim.

artworks.title: Sin, Death, and the Devil, vide Milton
artworks.medium: etching hand-colored with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene with three figures engaged in a conflict. The central character is emaciated, wearing a crown and holding a golden staff with a sphere emitting light. To the left is a snake-like figure with a large head, and to the right is a figure with wings and a staff. The background is filled with light and smoke. Text is visible at the top and bottom of the image.
